description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Length, which models and validates CSS length attributes within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Length
classes.description: Represents a Length as defined by CSS, with validation capabilities for minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new length object with optional minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a CSS length string against optional min and max bounds, returning the normalized length string or false if invalid.
